title: Spotted Dick Steamed Pudding
description: A traditional British steamed pudding made with suet and dried fruit, perfect for a cold winter's day.
instructions: Preheat the steamer or a large pot with a steamer basket.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, suet, dried fruit, brown sugar, eggs, milk, and spices. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into a greased 1-pint pudding basin or a heatproof bowl.
Cover the pudding with parchment paper or aluminum foil and tie with string.
Place the pudding in the steamer or pot and steam for 2 hours.
Remove the pudding from the steamer and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
